parts.name: base frame

physics.Basic_description: The main lower housing of the case, appearing as a matte grey-blue rectangular box with rounded corners in the RGB view.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the structural foundation and enclosure for the disc storage mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the side walls of the base firmly to stabilize the object during manipulation.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic casing enclosing empty space for the mechanism; treating as solid would vastly overestimate mass.

parts.description: The main lower housing of the case, appearing as a matte grey-blue rectangular box with rounded corners in the RGB view.
parts.function: Provides the structural foundation and enclosure for the disc storage mechanism.

parts.name: lid shell

physics.Basic_description: The top cover of the case, matching the base in matte grey-blue plastic finish, hinged at the back.
physics.Functional_description: Protects the discs and internal leaves from dust and damage when closed.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the front edge or top surface to lift and open the case.
physics.reason: Thin-walled plastic shell covering the interior cavity.

parts.description: The top cover of the case, matching the base in matte grey-blue plastic finish, hinged at the back.
parts.function: Protects the discs and internal leaves from dust and damage when closed.

parts.name: leaf plate 0

physics.Basic_description: A thin, dark plastic sheet or tray visible inside the case, part of the rotating page mechanism.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as a page to hold a CD securely via a central hub or clips.
physics.Grasped_description: Too thin and flexible to grasp reliably without damaging; manipulate via the case or disc.
physics.reason: Thin plastic sheet/tray structure; negligible volume compared to bounding box.

parts.description: A thin, dark plastic sheet or tray visible inside the case, part of the rotating page mechanism.
parts.function: Acts as a page to hold a CD securely via a central hub or clips.

parts.name: disc body 0

physics.Basic_description: A standard optical disc with a reflective silver/data side and a printed label side, appearing yellow/orange in the mask.
physics.Functional_description: Stores digital audio or data content.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp by the outer edge or center hole to avoid touching the data surface.
physics.reason: CDs are solid polycarbonate disks with a thin coating; effectively solid for mass calculation at this scale.

parts.description: A standard optical disc with a reflective silver/data side and a printed label side, appearing yellow/orange in the mask.

parts.name: disc marker 0

physics.Basic_description: The printed label area on the top surface of the disc, appearing as a radial pattern in the mask.
physics.Functional_description: Displays title and track information for the disc.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a graspable feature; part of the disc surface.
physics.reason: Thin printed layer or ink on the solid disc surface; treated as part of the solid disc assembly.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
